note: What it takes to turn this template into somebody's project: which files a new project gets, and which text in them carries a name. THE source of truth for that - scripts/rename.mjs executes it here, abap2UI5/mcp-server's lib/scaffold.mjs executes it over a checkout, and abap2UI5/vscode-extension snapshots it. Three programs, one description. Add a file or a substitution HERE.

templateOwn.README.md: describes the template itself; a project writes its own
templateOwn.CONTRIBUTING.md: how to contribute to the template, not to a project made from it
templateOwn.LICENSE: the template's copyright line, not the project's
templateOwn.scripts/rename.mjs: has nothing left to rename once it has renamed - and it reads template.json, which a project does not get either. Invoked as `node scripts/rename.mjs`, not through package.json, because every script in the SHARED package.json has to resolve to a shared file
templateOwn.scripts/check-template.mjs: gates this description against this repository; a project has no template.json to gate. Runs from .github/workflows/template-self-check.yml, which stays here too
templateOwn.scripts/generate-agents.mjs: regenerates the half of AGENTS.md this template mirrors from the framework guide; a project has the result, not the generator
templateOwn.scripts/app-guide-deviations.mjs: abap2UI5's `.github/shared/app-guide-deviations.mjs`, copied here for that generator - the guide's deviations are the template's, not a project's
templateOwn..github/workflows/pin-freshness.yml: weekly maintenance of the TEMPLATE's own framework pin, reported as an issue on this repository; a project decides its own pin policy and gets check.yml, which runs check:pin on every pull request
templateOwn..github/workflows/bump-linter.yaml: weekly maintenance of the TEMPLATE's own linter pin, gated by this repository's checks and opened as a PR here; a project decides its own bump policy the same way it decides its pin policy
templateOwn..github/workflows/template-self-check.ym: the gates that are about THIS repository rather than about a project made from it - template.json's description, the AGENTS.md mirror, and the unit tests for scripts/. check.yml used to run the first two and a project inherited steps it could not execute
templateOwn.scripts/test: unit tests for the scripts above, which a project does not get
templateOwn.scripts/lib: the substitution code scripts/rename.mjs and the create-abap2ui5-app package (create/) share; a project has nothing left to substitute, and no rename.mjs to import it
templateOwn.scripts/sync-create.mjs: copies scripts/lib/substitute.mjs into create/substitute.mjs (the published package has to be self-contained) and gates the copy byte-equal with --check from template-self-check.yml; a project publishes no package
templateOwn.scripts/generate-skills.mjs: mirrors the framework's four agent skills into .claude/skills/ here, with declared deviations; a project has the four SKILL.md files, not the generator
templateOwn.create: the `create-abap2ui5-app` npm package - `npm create abap2ui5-app` - which reads THIS template.json and writes a project; a project is what it produces, not what it contains. Published by .github/workflows/publish-create.yml
templateOwn..github/workflows/publish-create.yml: manual-dispatch publish of create/ to npm, with this repository's NPM_TOKEN; a project has no package to publish

class.why: The ABAP source writes the name lower case and the sidecar's CLSNAME upper case. Renaming half of it produces an object abapGit imports under one name and ABAP activates under another - which is the whole reason this is a script and not an instruction. The test include names the class too (the class under test, and the reference to its attributes), so it is listed here and renamed with the pair.
